name: choice
says: Options tapped as a set, against the key (choice_right).

name: order
says: Options in sequence, against every right order (choice_right ways).

name: cells
says: Each blank of a grid or table by its own exact ways (cells).

name: accept
says: Exact keys and aliases: numbers with tolerance, bands and units, fractions, algebra in any order, a forgiven typo (accept).

name: units
says: A unit or % the key states is part of the answer only when the question asks for it (give units, give your answer in cm, as a percentage) or the row's mark scheme withholds a mark without it (unit required, correct unit, 1 mark for unit); otherwise a bare number earns it, as GCSE and A-level schemes credit it. The key opts out with the unit in brackets, 40.5 (%), or a bare way beside it, 40.5% | 40.5.

name: peel
says: A long English answer by PEEL elements and the level table below (accept rule:peel).

name: points
says: Marking points counted, out of the maximum (accept rule:points).

name: graph
says: Every visual maths answer drawn on the grid or pad (graphs, bar charts, plotted points and lines, shaded regions, constructions, angles, shapes, translations, reflections) held against its key geometrically: points, lines, lengths, angles and areas within tolerance (draw_answer).

name: distilled
says: Long essays only (English, RS, History and the like): a rule set distilled offline for one part, rows of kind distilled {key, points}, marked as points. Data only; nothing is asked at run time.

name: unmarked
says: No exact key and no mechanical rule (a photo of handwritten words or working; a photo of a drawn answer is read by its geometry and marked by the draw marker): saved, verdict unmarked. Never a person, never live AI.
